comingLast.roast: off 29 and last, and already booking next week - good on him
at 1.1 a hole the suspense is entirely one-sided
2 clear with holes in hand - the maths likes him, the course may not
cushion of 2 over Barter - the bar has him at even money
with 3 to play and 2 in hand, boring golf is beautiful golf
2 points of insurance at 1.4 a hole - premium unpaid
the gap to Barter is 2 - his short game is now a public interest matter
3 clear of the worst seat in the house
above Barter by 3 - the safety rope is more of a shoelace
4 above Barter from the clubhouse - it never felt so thin from a chair
